# Language builtins

Signatures are the checker's own table: `name(parameter:kind...)`. `?` marks an optional parameter. Kinds: `series` any numeric series; `int` / `float` / `bool` / `string` / `color` a literal or an `input.*` (never a series); `plot` a handle from `p = plot(...)`; `any` a value; `strlist` an array literal of strings; `enum` one of the named constants. `[a..b]` is the accepted range of a literal.

## Series

`close` (float series), `open` (float series, needs ohlc), `high` (float series, needs ohlc), `low` (float series, needs ohlc), `hl2` (float series, needs ohlc), `hlc3` (float series, needs ohlc), `ohlc4` (float series, needs ohlc), `hlcc4` (float series, needs ohlc), `volume` (float series, needs volume), `time` (float series), `bar_index` (int series), `ta.tr` (float series, needs ohlc).

## Math and helpers

- `math.abs(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.sqrt(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.log(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.log10(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.exp(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.sin(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.cos(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.tan(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.asin(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.acos(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.atan(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.sinh(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.cosh(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.tanh(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.ceil(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.floor(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.trunc(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.sign(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.round(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.toradians(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.todegrees(x:series)` -> series float
- `math.pow(base:series, exponent:series)` -> series float
- `math.max(a:series, b:series)` -> series float
- `math.min(a:series, b:series)` -> series float
- `math.avg(a:series, b:series)` -> series float
- `nz(x:series, replacement?:series)` -> series float
- `na(x:series)` -> series bool
- `math.sum(source:series, length:int[1..5000])` -> series float

## Built-in ta.* kernels with no study of the same name

- `ta.rma(source:series, length:int[1..5000])` -> series float
- `ta.highest(source:series, length:int[1..5000])` -> series float
- `ta.lowest(source:series, length:int[1..5000])` -> series float
- `ta.stdev(source:series, length:int[1..5000])` -> series float
- `ta.variance(source:series, length:int[1..5000])` -> series float
- `ta.sum(source:series, length:int[1..5000])` -> series float
- `ta.highestbars(source:series, length:int[1..5000])` -> series int
- `ta.lowestbars(source:series, length:int[1..5000])` -> series int
- `ta.linreg(source:series, length:int[2..5000])` -> series float
- `ta.change(source:series, length?:int[1..5000])` -> series float
- `ta.crossover(a:series, b:series)` -> series bool
- `ta.crossunder(a:series, b:series)` -> series bool
- `ta.cross(a:series, b:series)` -> series bool
- `ta.bb(source:series, length:int[1..5000], mult:float[0..100])` -> [basis, upper, lower]

## Declarations and output

- `indicator(title:string, shorttitle?:string, overlay?:bool)` -> nothing
- `plot(series:series, title?:string, color?:color, linewidth?:int[1..8], style?:enum {plot.style_line|plot.style_histogram|plot.style_area}, offset?:int[-5000..5000], color_down?:color)` -> plot handle
- `hline(price:float, title?:string, color?:color, linestyle?:enum {hline.style_solid|hline.style_dashed|hline.style_dotted})` -> nothing
- `fill(plot1:plot, plot2:plot, color?:color, title?:string)` -> nothing
- `plotshape(series:any, title?:string, style?:enum {shape.circle|shape.square|shape.diamond|shape.triangleup|shape.triangledown|shape.arrowup|shape.arrowdown|shape.xcross|shape.cross}, location?:enum {location.abovebar|location.belowbar|location.absolute}, color?:color, offset?:int[-5000..5000])` -> nothing
- `color.new(color:color, transp:float[0..100])` -> color

## Inputs

- `input.int(defval:int, title?:string, minval?:int, maxval?:int, step?:int)` -> int
- `input.float(defval:float, title?:string, minval?:float, maxval?:float, step?:float)` -> float
- `input.bool(defval:bool, title?:string)` -> bool
- `input.string(defval:string, title?:string, options:strlist)` -> string
- `input.source(defval:any, title?:string)` -> series float
- `input.color(defval:color, title?:string)` -> color

## Constants

- math: `math.pi`, `math.e`
- plot: `plot.style_line`, `plot.style_histogram`, `plot.style_area`
- hline: `hline.style_solid`, `hline.style_dashed`, `hline.style_dotted`
- shape: `shape.circle`, `shape.square`, `shape.diamond`, `shape.triangleup`, `shape.triangledown`, `shape.arrowup`, `shape.arrowdown`, `shape.xcross`, `shape.cross`
- location: `location.abovebar`, `location.belowbar`, `location.absolute`
- color: `color.aqua`, `color.black`, `color.blue`, `color.fuchsia`, `color.gray`, `color.green`, `color.lime`, `color.maroon`, `color.navy`, `color.olive`, `color.orange`, `color.purple`, `color.red`, `color.silver`, `color.teal`, `color.white`, `color.yellow` (also `#rrggbb` and `#rrggbbaa` literals)
